label: [ Passoff Reading 066 ]

blocks.text: According to ancient superstitions, moles reveal a person’s character. For example, a mole on one’s nose means that he or she is strong-willed and trustworthy. Moles are also believed to foretell the future. A good illustration of these is that Having a mole over one’s right eyebrow means he or she will be lucky with money and have a successful career. Other instance in this category include a mole on the hand, the most desired, forecasting talent, health, and happiness.
